definitions.full: H5803. Azgad עַזְגָּד proper name, masculine Ασγαδ , Αζγαδ ( Gad is mighty ; Gray Prop. N. 145 ); — 1. a. head of family returning with Zerubbabel Ezra 2:12 = Neh 7:17 . b. returning with Ezra Ezra 8:12 . 2 one of those sealed Neh 10:16 .
